steps.label: Sessions / Connections
steps.sub: Runaway query or blocking chain — check first

steps.label: CPU → Memory → I/O
steps.sub: Elevated overall, or just one session?

code:
SELECT session_id, status, cpu_time, total_elapsed_time,
       wait_type, blocking_session_id
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests
WHERE session_id > 50
ORDER BY total_elapsed_time DESC;
caption: A populated blocking_session_id is often the whole answer.

code:
SELECT TOP 10 end_time, avg_cpu_percent,
       avg_memory_usage_percent, avg_data_io_percent
FROM sys.dm_db_resource_stats
ORDER BY end_time DESC;
caption: The same resource view from Lesson 41, now working an incident.
